diglett-night-slash.name: Night Slash
diglett-night-slash.description: Bond skill: pops up and slashes a foe (Power 90, Attack), leaving it Exposed for 1 turn.

diglett-earth-power.name: Earth Power
diglett-earth-power.description: Bond skill: the ground erupts under a foe up to 3 hexes away, no line of sight (Power 85).

diglett-sucker-punch.name: Sucker Punch
diglett-sucker-punch.description: Bond skill: strikes first from below (Power 60, Attack).

diglett-sand-force.name: Sand Force
diglett-sand-force.description: Deals 20% more damage to foes standing on mud.

diglett-tunneler.name: Tunneler
diglett-tunneler.description: Steps away from engaged foes without drawing free strikes.

diglett-sand-attack.name: Sand Attack
diglett-sand-attack.description: New skill: flings sand at a foe up to 2 hexes away, leaving it Weakened for 2 turns.

diglett-magnitude.name: Magnitude
diglett-magnitude.description: New skill: a tremor up to 1 hex away hitting foes in a 1-hex area (Power 55).

diglett-three-heads.name: Three Heads
diglett-three-heads.description: Each consecutive hit on the same foe deals 10% more damage, up to 3 stacks.

diglett-burrowed.name: Burrowed
diglett-burrowed.description: Takes 20% less damage while at full HP.

diglett-slash.name: Slash
diglett-slash.description: New skill: slashes an adjacent foe with sharp claws (Power 70).

diglett-scorching-sands.name: Scorching Sands
diglett-scorching-sands.description: New skill: hurls hot sand at a foe up to 2 hexes away (Power 70) and Burns it for 1 turn.

diglett-ambush.name: Ambush from Below
diglett-ambush.description: Deals 20% more damage to foes at full HP.

diglett-rapid-digging.name: Rapid Digging
diglett-rapid-digging.description: Regains 2 movement when it knocks out a foe on its turn.

diglett-drill-run.name: Drill Run
diglett-drill-run.description: New skill: bores through the ground into an adjacent foe (Power 95).

diglett-mud-bomb.name: Mud Bomb
diglett-mud-bomb.description: New skill: a mud ball up to 1 hex away hitting foes in a 1-hex area (Power 80).

diglett-dust-off.name: Dust Off
diglett-dust-off.description: Sheds statuses foes put on it at the start of its turn.

diglett-strike-from-below.name: Strike from Below
diglett-strike-from-below.description: Deals 15% more damage to foes engaged with one of its allies.

diglett-fissure.name: Fissure
diglett-fissure.description: New skill: splits the ground in a 2-hex line (Power 95).

diglett-bulldoze.name: Bulldoze
diglett-bulldoze.description: New skill: shakes the ground up to 1 hex away (Power 60), Slowing foes in a 1-hex area 2 turns.

diglett-tunnel-ambush.name: Tunnel Ambush
diglett-tunnel-ambush.description: Deals 15% more damage to adjacent foes.

diglett-earthshaker.name: Earthshaker
diglett-earthshaker.description: Capstone. Its Ground moves deal 20% more damage; pushing foes into obstacles deals 8 more damage.

diglett-underground-ace.name: Arena Trap
diglett-underground-ace.description: Capstone. Foes engaged with it can never slip away freely; its free strikes on them deal 25% more.
